chunks: Indeed, the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله was one day leading his companions in salat (prayer), and he heard the crying of a child, so he lightened the prayer.

key_terms.ٱلنَّبِيَّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: How did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله act when he heard a child crying during congregational salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the Prophet’s صلى الله عليه وآله consideration and mercy while leading congregational salat (prayer). When he heard a child crying, he shortened the prayer, showing attentiveness to the needs of others within worship.
